body.title: GH_COVERAGE, GH_INPUTS and their tests
body.summary: Add the coverage and input inventory data, check that all 68 tools are registered, and add the tests that read the installed gh: command coverage, flags from FLAGS, positionals from USAGE, synthetic rows, per-op schema accounting and the prompt sweep.
acceptanceChecks: every command of the installed gh has a GH_COVERAGE row and every excluded row has a reason
every flag and positional has a GH_INPUTS row and every schema field is accounted for
the prompt sweep fails on an optional selector whose absence makes gh prompt

tests.name: gh-coverage.test.ts: every installed gh command has a GH_COVERAGE row, covered rows name registered tools and ops, excluded rows have a reason, and all 68 tools are registered
gh-inputs.test.ts: every flag and positional has a GH_INPUTS row and every schema field is accounted for by a flag, positional or synthetic row
gh-inputs.test.ts: prompt sweep reads the prompt cases from the installed gh help and requires each argument in the schema or always passed
